My published work spans streaming data pipelines, distributed analytics,
crop-yield prediction, educational software, and IoT security. These experiences
inform my current interests in streaming systems, machine-learning infrastructure,
and reproducible research tools.

This page distinguishes **published work**, **current interests**, and
**engineering projects**, with links to the underlying artifacts.

## Working themes

::: {.record-grid}
::: {.record-link}
### Streaming computation
Constructing inputs, joining streams, narrowing candidate sets, and reasoning
about changing data. [UMatch](../contributions/umatch/index.qmd) is an engineering
starting point.
:::
::: {.record-link}
### ML & data infrastructure
Connecting data pipelines, real-time services, cloud systems, and operational
reliability. See my [engineering background](../about/index.qmd).
:::
::: {.record-link}
### Reproducible workflows
Connecting source discovery, implementation, and reviewable artifacts in the
[research-writing framework](../contributions/research-workflows/index.qmd).
:::
:::

## Published research

- **Streaming pipelines and distributed analytics:**
  [Git-Archive Data Pipeline](../publications/git-archive-data-pipeline/index.qmd)
  (thesis, 2019) and the
  [Hadoop / Apache Mahout paper](../publications/hadoop-apache-mahout/index.qmd)
  (IEEE CCWC, 2019).
- **Applied machine learning:**
  [Prediction of Crop Cultivation](../publications/prediction-of-crop-cultivation/index.qmd)
  (IEEE CCWC, 2019), comparing regression approaches for an agricultural prediction task.
- **Educational systems:**
  [Online Examination Empowerment](../publications/online-examination-empowerment/index.qmd)
  (IRJET, 2016), documenting a Java-based examination-preparation framework.
- **Connected-device security:**
  [Accustoms of IOT and Security Concerns](../publications/iot-security-concerns/index.qmd)
  (IRJET, 2016), a survey of existing security concerns and reports.

[Complete author lists, publication details, and citations](../publications/index.qmd)

## From question to artifact

A complete record connects the question and prior work to a method, implementation,
evaluation, bounded conclusion, and reproducible artifact. It records limitations,
negative results, and changes to the original plan—not only successful outcomes.
